note: NPC goals and schedules (M4.4, ADR 0008). Design data: where NPCs go and when. Hours are whole hours 0-24 (from > to wraps past midnight). Book 1 shows little of daily routines, so most of this is a guess; goals tied to a canon event say so in 'notes'. The Dragon never leaves its lair and is not here.

erin_solstice.notes: Day 8: Erin walks to Liscor for supplies (b1.erin_walks_to_liscor, b1.lism_overcharges_erin). Otherwise she runs the inn and forages blue fruit. M8.7: Toren drags her north on day 70 (erin.stranded_north, erin.left_liscor, off the map); from day 71 (erin.in_celum) she cooks, serves and sleeps at the Frenzied Hare in Celum and visits Stitchworks after lunch. Hours in Celum are guesses.

relc.notes: Day 9 dawn: Relc brings Goblin heads to the inn (b1.relc_brings_goblin_heads). Stays away from the inn after Erin throws him out, and again after he blames her for Klbkch (1.30).

zevara.notes: A short morning check at the east gate; otherwise in the Watch barracks. Combat block (M7.4): she holds the gate against the dead on day 39 (1.60 stage); her fire breath is not modelled.

selys.notes: Works at the Adventurer's Guild (off-map); lunch in the market.

pisces.notes: Hunted by the Watch after day 7 (b1.pisces_arrest_and_escape): hides in the wilds, out on the Floodplains at night. Combat block (M7.4): his neck-snapping spells at the gate on day 39 (1.60 stage), as plain damage. M9.1: gone with the Horns to Albez from day 72 (horns_of_hammerad.gone_to_albez, 3.02H), so no more nights on the Floodplains.

rags.notes: Forages the fruit trees with the gatherer. Watches the inn after Erin spares her (b1.erin_buries_goblin_pair).

goblin_chieftain.notes: Stays with the tribe in the wilds.

pawn.notes: After he names himself (1.30), Pawn brings Workers to the inn each evening or every other evening, when the sun meets the mountains (1.34). Before that he works in the Hive. He stays away while Ksmvr holds him for judgment (1.49-1.50), and after he goes home to the Hive (1.53): he visits once more on the morning of day 39 (1.57H, not scheduled), and Ksmvr keeps him in the Hive that night (1.60).

designated_worker.notes: Works in the Hive until the raid on day 21 (1.29), when a canon stage brings him to the inn with Klbkch.

toren.notes: Pisces's skeleton (1.41). Once it exists it never leaves the inn: it cleans, carries water and fruit, and guards Erin. Before day 27 it is not made yet (off the map). M8.7: on day 70 it drags Erin north and leaves her (toren.left_erin); from then on it is off the map.

ksmvr.notes: The Prognugator of Liscor's Hive (1.46). He stays in the Hive (off the map); a canon stage brings him out to fight Gazi on day 42 (2.05). Combat block (M8.1): four arms, two swords and two daggers.

bird.notes: A Worker of Erin's chess club (1.60-1.63). A canon stage brings him to the inn hill on the night of day 39; otherwise he is in the Hive (off the map).

calruz.notes: The Horns of Hammerad lodge upstairs at the inn from night 35 (1.49): breakfast and evenings in the common room, days in Liscor and at the ruins. Before that they are elsewhere (off the map). No dinner on day 39: they are in the ruins (1.57H-1.59H); after that night they are gone.

Before that they are elsewhere (off the map). No dinner on day 39: they are in the ruins (1.57H-1.59H); after that night they are gone.

wesle.notes: Celum's gate guard (1.19R). Hours are a guess (M8.5).

fals.notes: M9.2. A senior City Runner who takes his jobs at the Celum Runners' Guild (3.04, 3.09); he runs them off the map. Hours are guesses. The 3.09 scene brings him to the Frenzied Hare on day 76.

stenei.notes: [Receptionist] at Celum's Runners' Guild (1.33R). Hours are a guess (M8.5).

lyonette.notes: M9.1. Erin takes her in on day 50 (lyonette.works_at_inn). She cooks and cleans in the kitchen, serves in the evening and sleeps in the back room. After Erin is gone (day 70) she runs the inn alone (3.05); the text has her hiding for some days first, which is not scheduled. Hours are guesses.

mrsha.notes: M9.1. The white Gnoll cub stays at the inn once Ryoka brings her (mrsha.at_the_wandering_inn, day 67). From day 71 Selys looks after her in Liscor (mrsha.in_selys_care), off the map, until she runs back to the inn (3.21, M9.4 clears the flag). Positions are guesses.

ryoka_griffin.notes: M9.1. Teriarch sends her to Celum on day 71 (ryoka.in_celum). There she takes deliveries at the Runners' Guild in the morning, runs them off the map, and eats and sleeps at the Frenzied Hare near Erin (3.03). She leaves Celum with Reynold in 3.09/3.10 (ryoka.gone_to_magnolia, set in M9.2). Before day 71 she keeps story roles only. Hours are guesses. She never gains a level; the combat block is a design number.

ylawes_byres.notes: M9.3. The Gold-rank [Knight] comes to Esthelm to lay its dead to rest (3.18T, ylawes.at_esthelm) and holds the north-west quarter of the ruins behind his barricades until the last battle (3.19T-3.20T). He stands by the palisade gate; where he sleeps is not shown. Before that he keeps story roles only. The combat block is a design number for a Gold-rank adventurer.
